text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
My aim is to claim the first European<n>G1 victory as
a Tracen athlete.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Trainer suggests the Prix Maurice de<n>Gheest. It's a
1,300-meter G1 sprint,<n>and I feel a strong sense of
affinity<n>with this destined race of mine.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
It takes place before the Prix Jacques<n>Le Marois,
so if I win it, there's a<n>high possibility people will
think I did it<n>to steal Taiki's glory.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The Prix Maurice de Gheest or the<n>Prix Jacques Le
Marois... We can<n>decide which one I'll run in after
I'm<n>done with the Yasuda Kinen!
